text: Over the two days since the last run on 4 November, beauty gained about 53,000 new reviews, about five times any other category, led by two cheap perfumes (Wildplay +7,117 and French Essence +6,924), with health, home and kids' wear next. For a beginner, home & kitchen and jewellery still look best: ₹91 fridge covers (+1,592) and ₹98 wall hooks (+1,190) are moving fast, and jewellery stays light, cheap and low on complaints.

headline: Women's ethnic: everyday kurtis keep growing, shimmer sarees hold up
text: Kurtis still have the most reviews overall, and a ₹237 kurti (+482) and a ₹200 kurti (+352) gained the most since the last run two days ago. Among sarees, a ₹390 shimmer saree with mirror work gained 340 reviews, and bandhani and net sarees are new to the page as Diwali (8 November) and Chhath approach. The typical price is about ₹291, and about 9.4% of reviews are 1-star. Gujarat and Rajasthan sellers lead, so price competition is strong. Free-size sarees are an easier start than sized kurtis, but it is too late for festive stock now.

headline: Women's western: shirts and tank tops lead, jackets keep rising
text: A ₹194 women's shirt gained the most reviews in the two days since the last run (+397), followed by ₹165 and ₹209 tank tops. A ₹294 girls' jacket (+301) and a ₹297 women's jacket new to the page show winter demand building. The typical price is about ₹281, with about 7.3% 1-star reviews, lower than most clothing here. Delhi sellers lead by a wide margin, then Gujarat. Sizes still mean returns, so start with a small range.

headline: Men's clothing: slowest growth, but sweatshirts are arriving
text: This category again gained the fewest new reviews, only about 800 in two days, mostly on shirts priced ₹248 to ₹395. Several hoodies and fleece sweatshirts are new to the page, which fits the start of winter, but few have large review counts yet. About 11.7% of reviews are 1-star, the second-highest after electronics, which points to quality complaints and returns. The typical price is about ₹333, and Punjab, Delhi and Rajasthan sellers lead. It is not a good first category unless you have a reliable supplier.

headline: Kids & toys: cheap sets and winter socks keep moving
text: Kids gained about 8,200 new reviews in two days, the fourth-most of any category. A ₹182 three-pack cat print set (+864) leads, and ₹121 baby socks (+610) and a ₹203 kids' sweater set (+552) are climbing with the cold weather. The typical price is low at about ₹182, so margins are thin, and about 7.6% of reviews are 1-star. Toys such as the ₹80 magic practice book have no sizes, which makes them the easier way in, and building blocks and doctor sets are new to the page. Gujarat and Delhi sellers lead.

headline: Home & kitchen: ₹91 fridge covers lead a strong two days
text: A ₹91 fridge cover gained the most reviews in the two days since the last run (+1,592), followed by ₹98 cotton wicks (+1,330), ₹98 sticky wall hooks (+1,190) and another fridge cover (+1,099). The wicks and artificial marigold flowers are likely Diwali buying, so don't start on those now, since Diwali is on 8 November. The typical price is about ₹163, and about 7.1% of reviews are 1-star. These items are light and have no sizes, which suits a beginner. Gujarat and Delhi sellers lead, and this category had 34 usable products today.

headline: Beauty: the biggest growth by far, and perfumes led it
text: Beauty gained about 53,000 reviews in two days, far more than any other category, led by Wildplay (+7,117) and French Essence (+6,924) perfumes at under ₹150, then Ghar Soaps face wash and Mamaearth face wash. Perfume gifting before Diwali is a likely reason for the jump, so it may cool afterwards. Most top sellers are brands, and reselling them usually needs the brand's authorisation, while making your own cosmetics needs a licence. Unbranded tools such as a ₹94 silicone back scrubber are the realistic entry. The typical price is about ₹189, with about 8.2% 1-star reviews, and this category had 33 usable products today.

headline: Jewellery: steady, light and ahead of wedding season
text: Jewellery sets remain the largest type, and a ₹142 rhodium set gained the most since the last run (+667), followed by a ₹151 bracelet and ₹135 oxidised jhumkas. Growth is modest at about 4,000 reviews in two days. Bridal items such as a heavy gold-plated bridal set and a flower jewellery set for mehandi are new to the page, which fits the wedding season starting later this month. The typical price is about ₹166, and about 7.1% of reviews are 1-star. Items are very light with mostly no sizes, so shipping and returns stay easy; Gujarat and Maharashtra sellers lead.

headline: Bags & footwear: sling bags and handbags move steadily
text: A ₹151 women's sling bag gained the most reviews in two days (+352), with a ₹114 men's wallet, shoulder bags and a backpack close behind. The wallet's listing uses the BMW name, so don't copy that: use plain designs with no brand names. Handbags remain the largest type overall. The typical price is about ₹204, and about 7.4% of reviews are 1-star. Bags and wallets have no sizes while footwear does, so start with bags; Delhi sellers lead by a wide margin.

headline: Electronics: speakers and holders grow, complaints stay highest
text: A ₹382 wooden Bluetooth speaker gained the most in two days (+381), followed by an ₹84 phone holder pack (+298) and a ₹186 selfie stick tripod (+227). Many earbud listings are new to the page, but this category has the highest 1-star share at about 15.2%, which suggests quality problems and returns. The typical price is about ₹325, while phone holders sell for about ₹82 to ₹115. If you try this category, start with holders and stands, not earbuds. Delhi, Haryana and Gujarat sellers lead.

headline: Health & fitness: branded basics lead, ear-lobe patches keep selling
text: Health gained about 10,900 new reviews in two days, the second-most of any category, led by Dabur Red toothpaste (+2,895) and Everteen and Stayfree pads, which a beginner can't easily resell without authorisation. Ear-lobe support patches at about ₹68 are the unbranded item that keeps selling (+892 on the top one). Badminton rackets, shuttlecocks and footballs are new to the page or ranking high, showing sports demand. It has the lowest 1-star share of any category at about 5.8%, and the typical price is about ₹237. Delhi, Gujarat and Uttar Pradesh sellers lead.

Fridge covers, about ₹91 to ₹101, the fastest-moving home item of the last two days.
Sticky wall hooks, about ₹98 to ₹110, light and with no sizes.
Jewellery sets and bracelets, about ₹140 to ₹175, for the wedding season starting later this month.
Ear-lobe support patches, about ₹68, a low-priced health seller gaining nearly 900 reviews in two days.
Women's sling bags and handbags, about ₹150 to ₹260, plain designs with no brand names.
Phone holders and stands, about ₹82 to ₹115, as the simple alternative to earbuds.

Avoid for now: earbuds and men's clothing (most complaints), sized clothing in general (returns), branded beauty, perfumes and pads (need authorisation), anything using a brand name you don't own, and Diwali-only stock such as wicks and marigolds (too late to start).
